annotations.text:
Running order, left to right, top to bottom. Eleven slides.

The live demo screens are gone — slide 07 is the still that stands in for the video.

Remaining blanks: team names (01, 11), reviewer name (05), and the end-to-end timing on 08.
Both figures here are marked [verify]. Confirm them against the IDA and CDC pages and drop the marker — a judge who knows the number and catches it wrong will not trust anything after it.

The slide the brief asks for by name: one passage, two learners, two shapes. Slide 05 is the other required one — the side-by-side check against the source.

The passage is the real preloaded sample from server/ingest/samples.js, so the deck and the demo video show the same text.
If you run over time, slide 10 is the first cut — its opening column makes the same argument as card 3 on slide 09.
